source_clock_semantics: legacy built_at is artifact generation and retained separately; DWD known-from and provider acquisition stay unavailable; envelope cutoff is retrospective only
listing_identity: content digest of the exact accepted security-code-validity interval; research reference, not invented DWD listing_id
action_boundary: normalized actions plus accepted supplemental action/rights dates and retained blocked intervals
multiple_process_policy: retain every 20-session process; any qualified persistent failure proposes one reduce-only action; lexicographic process_id is only the evidence witness
missing_effect: no additional sell; retain all baseline safety decisions
shadow_state: original B state only; proposals are not hypothetical fills
continuation: no final action difference or only one distinct entry episode parks the candidate
